IGUI_WaterPipes_SoundEnabled_tooltip: Looping ambient hum played by working machines, such as the electric purifier while it is powered. Turn off for total silence.
IGUI_WaterPipes_SoundVolume_tooltip: Volume of the mod's machine sounds, from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest).
IGUI_WaterPipes_EffectsEnabled_tooltip: Animated water spray drawn over running sprinklers and open fire hydrants. Purely visual; turn off if you prefer no effects or want to save a little performance.
IGUI_WaterPipesPressureModelOff: Pressure is switched off in this game's sandbox options.
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterPressure: Pressure at this emitter: %1 m of head
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterLow: Not enough to water (needs %1). Add a pump, shorten the run, or raise the limit on the router feeding it.
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterShort: Cannot water: the line needs at least %1 m more pressure for it. Add a pump, shorten the run, or move some emitters onto another line.
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterDry: There is no water in the network for it to draw. Fill a container on the line, or switch on a pump with a source.
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterBurstRisk: Close to bursting (blows out above %1). Put a router in between and set a limit.
IGUI_WaterPipesEmitterBurst: Blown out by too much pressure. Repair it with a Pipe Wrench and Duct Tape.
IGUI_WaterPipesDripBurst: Blown out by too much pressure. It still carries water, but it has stopped watering.
IGUI_WaterPipesRouterPressureHint: Cap the pressure this router passes downstream:
IGUI_WaterPipesRouterPressureInlet: Arriving at the valve: %1 m of head
IGUI_WaterPipesRouterPressureOutlet: Leaving the valve: %1 m of head
IGUI_WaterPipesHydrantMainsFed: Mains-fed: flows freely while the town water is on.
IGUI_WaterPipesHydrantReserve: Water left in the main: %1 L.
IGUI_WaterPipesHydrantNeedsPipe: Lay a pipe on its tile to connect it to your network.
IGUI_WaterPipesPumpNoSource: No well or open water in reach: this pump only adds pressure.
IGUI_WaterPipesPumpDrawingWater: Drawing dirty water from open water.
IGUI_WaterPipesPumpSourceWellIdle: A well is in reach, but the pump is not running.
IGUI_WaterPipesPumpSourceWaterIdle: Open water is in reach, but the pump is not running.
IGUI_WaterPipesPumpWouldGain: Turning it on would add %1 m.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveOpenDesc: Water passes through. This side and the far side are one network.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveClosedDesc: Nothing passes, either way. The two sides are separate networks and share no water, pressure or contamination.
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingDesc: Runs a concealed pipe tree from the tile you clicked to every sink, toilet and washer in the building, climbing to other floors through the walls. Costs %1 Iron Pipe(s) per fixture connected, taken when the work starts; a fixture it cannot reach is refunded. Pipes you already laid are reused, never built over. Pipe laid this way gives nothing back when dismantled.
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingTruncated: This building is too big to survey in one go: only the part nearest you was planned.
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingReason_noCli: no wall to reach its floor
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingReason_would: connecting it would close a loop
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingReason_overC: over the distance limit, build again from another spot
IGUI_WaterPipesPlumbBuildingRefusal_noFi: no fixture here left to connect
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMax: Between the two: holds until it reaches the maximum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_towardMin: Between the two: holds until it reaches the minimum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noEdge: Between the two: waiting for it to reach either end
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noCrop: Nothing to measure: plant something here
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorReason_noPower: No power: no electricity on the tile and no charged battery
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorInvert: Invert: switch on at the maximum and off at the minimum
IGUI_WaterPipesSensorSelecting: Click a valve to link or unlink it. Esc to finish.
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_outOfRange: That valve is too far from the sensor
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_safehouse: That valve is in a safehouse you are not a member of
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noValve: There is no valve there any more
IGUI_WaterPipesSignalRefused_noSensor: The sensor is gone, or you are too far from it
IGUI_WaterPipesValveLinked: Driven by %1 moisture sensor(s): it opens while any of them gives a signal.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveSwitchOff: Switched off by hand: it stays closed whatever the sensors say.
IGUI_WaterPipesValveWaiting: Switched on, but no sensor is giving a signal, so it stays closed.
